title: Zac Taylor on Shemar Stewart being inactive: He's making progress, but we have a deep group

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Zac Taylor on Shemar Stewart being inactive: He's making progress, but we have a deep group
sources.description: The decision to make defensive end Shemar Stewart a healthy scratch on Sunday was the subject of a question for Bengals head coach Zac Taylor at a Monday press conference.
